text: BUFF_ATTACK does not multiply damage by 1.5 - it multiplies the minDamage FLOOR by 1.5 and leaves damageRange untouched. Damage rolls as minDamage + random()*damageRange, so under the buff the expected damage rises by 1.5*minDamage - minDamage, i.e. strictly LESS than a 1.5x total unless damageRange is zero. Consequence for the contaminated duel_dense footage: it is inflated, but 'divide by 1.5' is the wrong correction and would under-report the true TTK. The same is true of BUFF_INJURED (x0.5 on minDamage and defense and baseSlashLength) and BUFF_DEFENSE (x1.5 on defense only).

text: slashLength / InputManager.maxDistance is an ARC-LENGTH budget for the drawn line, not a radial reach.
